verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your own infrastructure, with your own servers, browsers and LLM API keys, backed by a dedicated self-hosted overview section. The llms.txt probe describes Skyvern as open source, it has a public GitHub repo, and a community member independently confirms it is AGPL3-licensed, which corroborates that the core code is available to self-host. missing for 10: hands-on community reports of actually running a self-hosted deployment, deployment/installation details (e.g., Docker or system requirements), clarity on feature parity between self-hosted and the Cloud UI.
